notes.title: Alpha Version Update Sep.19th
notes.content:
[h3]■ Important[/h3][p]This update contains content for the Craftopia [b]alpha-unstable[/b] version.

The [b]alpha-unstable[/b] version allows you to experience new content in advance but there may be unstable behaviour, bugs, and specification changes.

[/p][h3]■Update Topic[/h3][p]- Reorganized the Craft facilities in Creative Mode’s Item Filter by category.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where connecting the "Supply Group Chest" and "Sorting Pipe" would duplicate captured enemies.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where item selection in the "Supply Group Chest" would sometimes not function correctly.[/p][p][/p][p]*In addition to this, various other changes are included! Select "Beta" and change "Participate in beta" to "alpha-unstable."
Wait for the game to download the new build and then launch it.

● Reporting Bugs
When reporting bugs, please provide detailed information about what you were doing, what you were trying to do, and the circumstances before and after the bug occurred. Additionally, if you have images or videos of the bug at the time of occurrence, it would be appreciated if you could attach them.
Please attach files such as "save data" or "log files" that may be required for bug fixes when reporting.[/p]

notes.title: 5th Anniversary Update Patch v20250908.1752
notes.content: [p]◆ Newly Added Content[/p][p]- Added new items ""0 Degree Cannon"" and ""90 Degree Cannon"".[/p][p]- You can now ride on top of rails with a hoverboard.[/p][p]- Introduced a new landscape editing feature allowing players to customize landscape in the Empty Island.[/p][p]Deploy and use ""Altar of Creation"" to place landscape items from a bird's-eye-view, to edit your island as you see fit.[/p][p]- Added ""Supply Group Chest"".[/p][p]""Supply Group Chest"" is a facility that can be built in the Empty Island, and you can order ""Captured Enemies"" to collect items![/p][p]Even while you're away from the island, they will keep working to collect items based on their traits![/p][p]- Added new item ""World Heritage: Pyramid"".[/p][p]- Added ""Raid Support Camp"".[/p][p]""Captured Enemies"" assigned in this camp will fight alongside you during the raid.[/p][p]""Captured Enemies"" can now be leveled up using ""Monster Merging Facility"".[/p][p]- Added new item ""Mootorcycle"".[/p][p]- Added new module items ""Flamethrower"" and ""Armor Plate Module"".[/p][p]- Added a new item, “Item-Yielding Tree”.[/p][p]It can be planted on the Empty Island, and will yield items when watered and fertilized.[/p][p]- Added a new vehicle with a special design ""Mono Airplane"" and a commemorative object ""5th Anniversary Mount Rushmono""![/p][p]""Mount Rushmono"" can be built on the Empty Island using ""Altar of Creation"" added in this update.[/p][p]- Normal goblins will drop ""5th Anniversary Mono Coin"" in September. Those coins will be used to craft 5th anniversary items.[/p][p]- Added a high-difficulty repeatable dungeon to Ruin of the End.[/p][p]Note: Rewards remain unchanged. Please enjoy it as a pure challenge.[/p][p]- New achievements have been implemented.[/p][p]- Added new item "Landscaping Workbench". [/p][p]This workbench allows you to craft Custom Landscape items.[/p][p]◆ Balance Adjustments[/p][p]- Changed the burning status so it cannot be reapplied for 3 seconds after it ends.[/p][p]◆ Functional Improvements[/p][p]- Added the ""About Mod Usage"" dialogue that pops up when you launch the game for the first time after updating the game.[/p][p]- Added the version command on dedicated servers to display the current game version.[/p][p]- Slightly lowered the brightness of grass.[/p][p]- Adjusted the muzzle flash of the vehicle Biplane so that it now inherits the biplane’s speed.[/p][p]- The ""Grave"" created when a player dies now spawns inside the boundary of the world.[/p][p]- Adjusted player colors in multiplayer so that players from the 9th onward now have slightly different colors.[/p][p]- The boss area of Anubis will now close off over time.[/p][p]- Added sound effects to the bosses ""Messenger of God"", ""Hydra"", and ""Anubis"".[/p][p]- It is now possible to capture and keep Lizard Guillotine and Pekomet as pets.[/p][p]◆ Performance Improvements[/p][p]- Optimized some processes.[/p][p]◆ Bug Fixes[/p][p]- Fixed the placement of the unlock text and button animation of the slate screen.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where certain gamepad inputs were not recognized during world creation.[/p][p]- Adjusted raid progression conditions to improve overall stability.[/p][p]After a raid begins, if no players are present within the raid area for a set period of time, the raid will automatically end in failure.[/p][p]Similarly, if players move too far away from the defense target during a raid, the raid will also automatically end in failure after a certain period of time.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where players would not take damage from lava waterfalls.[/p][p]- Slightly lowered the sea level on the Empty Island.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where Gun IV series parameters were not displaying correctly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the name for Flame Grass wasn't displayed in Japanese.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the ""Auto Furniture Assembly Machine"" was being used as a material for the ""Latest Automatic Assembler"".[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where one-handed swords and spears became misaligned when equipped while wearing a Beast Hunter Coat.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where it was possible to walk through walls at certain points of the snowy mountain.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that turned the rank of certain items to 0.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the minecart derailed at the start of a rail.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where buildings that could not be recovered would incorrectly react to the recovery rod.[/p][p]- Tweaked an issue where the building placement error message would not disappear.[/p][p]- The positioning of ""Citadel Hand Rail A,"" ""Citadel Hand Rail C,"" and ""Citadel Stair Rail A"" have been corrected.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where walls and floors would not break when attacked by enemies.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that ""4th Anniversary Monoment"" was not displayed in a guest player's screen in multiplayer.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the ""Marauder's"" and ""Marauder Leader's"" enchantment fragments were not displayed on the list.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where enemy rage/fatigue status was not synchronized in multiplayer.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where certain effects would continue to display when the boss Messenger of God transitioned to its second phase.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the fully automatic agricultural robot's progress would not be saved.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the Alligator Turtle would not move.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where certain enemies would appear sideways.[/p][p]Note: This is not fixing everything in a one batch. Only the enemies identified with this issues were fixed. If you discover other enemies or locations with the same issue, please report them to us.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where a Guard Machinegun Turret would aim at another Guard Machinegun Turret to shoot.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue that you couldn't control a character after mounting other player's pet in multiplayer.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where you could not clear the main missions ""Memories of the Quicksand Labyrinth,"" ""Memories of the Labyrinth of Pollution,"" and ""Memories of the Ruin of the End.""[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where safe areas in the dungeon ""Old Garden of Undead"" were not set correctly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the boss area countdown would start before the boss area was officially unlocked in the dungeon ""Old Garden of Undead.""[/p]

notes.title: Craftopia Celebrates Its 5th Anniversary!
notes.content: [p]Today, September 4, 2025, Craftopia celebrates its 5th anniversary since releasing into early access![/p][p][/p][p]We would like to thank all our players, from the bottom of our hearts, for supporting Craftopia over these years.[/p][p][/p][p]The 5th anniversary update is scheduled to be released on Tuesday, September 9, 2025![/p][p][/p][p]Until now, our updates have mainly focused on expanding the world map as part of the shift to a seamless world experience. In our previous update, we introduced the "Empty Island," which allows players to enjoy Craftopia their way without having to worry about the terrain getting in the way![/p][p]For this 5th anniversary, we take that idea even further with a brand-new landscape editing feature! Now you can design the world as you see fit![/p][p][/p][p]Please check out the 5th Anniversary Update trailer to see this exciting new feature for yourself![/p][previewyoutube="hrsMvfDSAB8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Craftopia will continue moving forward toward its 6th anniversary and its full release.[/p][p]We are committed to working hard for you, our fans, who have been so passionate about this labour of love of ours.[/p][p]We hope you'll continue to support us on this wonderful journey.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for playing Craftopia![/p][p][/p][p]Craftopia Development Team[/p]

notes.title: 2025 Summer Update Patch v20250623.1820
notes.content: [p]◆ Newly Added Content[/p][p]- Unlocked new caves in ""Brigandine Valley"", ""Sherbert Iceberg,"", ""Unnefell Deser"", and ""Miasma Wetlands"".[/p][p]- Unlocked the new era ""Craftopia Era"". New items are available to craft.[/p][p]- Added a button to refund allocated skill points, making it easier to reallocate them to other skills.[/p][p]- Added a new world “Empty Island”.[/p][p]You can select “Empty Island” from the world selection screen.[/p][p]Use ""Inter-character Cloud Storage"" to bring items from your regular world and create your very own island![/p][p]Items that allow for terrain customization are planned to be added in future updates.[/p][p]- ""Merchant Smith"" visits the village in ""Inferno Volcano"".[/p][p]- Added new weapons:[/p][p]• Energy Bullet[/p][p]Those weapons below can be crafted with ""Blueprints"", and can be used to shoot ""Energy Bullet"" if equipped:[/p][p]• Rifle IV[/p][p]• Assault Rifle IV[/p][p]• Shotgun IV[/p][p]• Submachine Gun IV[/p][p]- Added ""Blueprint of Wooden Stick"".[/p][p]- Added a new item ""Garbage"". You can craft it on ""Workbench"".[/p][p]- Added a new item ""Vacuum Cleaner"".[/p][p]You can pull in and collect items from the direction you're aiming with it.[/p][p]- Added attachments for guns.[/p][p]After you find ""Blueprints"" for those attachments somewhere in the world, you will be able to craft them.[/p][p]- Added a new item ""Farming Hoe"".[/p][p]Attacking Farming Plots with Farming Hoe tills soils, and you can harvest more crops from those plots.[/p][p]- Added a new item ""Inter-character Cloud Storage"".[/p][p]Items stored in this storage can be shared between your characters.[/p][p]- Added two new items: “World Heritage: Statue of Liberty” and “World Heritage: Parthenon”.[/p][p]They can only be constructed at specific locations on an Empty Island, and grant notes.title: 2025 Spring Update Patch v20250313.0451
notes.content:
◆ Newly Added Content
- Added a command to show the current FPS.
- Added a cache clearing function to the ESC menu and dedicated server commands.
- Added element attributes to various weapon.
There are 3 element attributes, fire, lightning, ice, at the moment, and when you attack enemies with the element attributes they're weak to, your attack will deal greater damage.
- Goblins, Gremlins, and Wizards who have element attributes will drop new weapon items.
- Added new farming automation items.
- Added new fishing-related items.
- Fish Farm
- Farmed Fish Feed Lv1
- Farmed Fish Feed Lv2
- Angler's Fishing Rod
- Added new crop items.
- Added new item ""Massacre Drone"". They replace Cauldron and cull excess livestock.
- Added ""Killpower Switch"".
This switch will enrage Anubis in hell and allow you to fight Anubis who will do their best to kill you.
Anubis in hell of Lv 100 or more will drop this item.

◆ Balance Adjustments
- Changed the maximum number of blueprint items that you can offer in Picture Book to 1.
- Adjusted the basic attacks of the spear. The input operation for kicks during normal attacks has been shortened to allow canceling animation. This enables you to move quickly and guard yourself with a shield with a shorter time required.
- You would less likely to take fall damage while riding on hovering vehicles.
- Adjusted status effect resistances for various mobs.
- Increased the range that the boss ""Bone Dragon"" uses some of their ranged attack.
- Flower attack of the boss ""Fleur"" will not be generated on colliders that deal damage to objects upon contact.
- The following adjustments have been made to the boss ""Inferno Whale"":
• Made the activation of the Anti-Whale Pike easier;
• Added tutorial popup when interacting with Bombardment;
• Added information to the Bombartment tutorial explaining that it automatically aims at a target;
• Adjusted the position of Bombardment to make it easier to load cannonballs;
• Increased the spawn interval of cannonballs;
• Cannonballs will now spawn at the beginning of the game;
• Added information to the Mounted Machine Gun tutorial explaining that guarding is possible and that missiles can be shot down;
• Added information to the Mounted Machine Gun when interacting with it to indicate that guarding is possible;
• Removed some Balloon Bombs that were out of the shooting range of Mounted Machine Gun;
• Repositioned the Balloon Bombs near the Rockfall Machine closer to the Anti-Whale Pike;
• Repositioned the Balloon Bombs in front of the the Gigantic Chain Restraint Bullet Ballista closer to the boss's spawn location;
• Increased the damage of Balloon Bombs, Reflecting Mirrors, and Timed Mines;
• Reduced the Life of the boss’s spine and the damage it deals upon destruction;
• Added a large arrow indicating direction near the Rockfall Machine;
• Decreased the boss’s Life;
• Slightly increased the Life of the Defense Target.
- During the hell boss ""Anubis"" suction explosion, shields will be disabled, and the suction duration has been shortened.
- Teleporting of the hell boss ""Anubis"" can no longer be canceled.
- Increased the stacking amount of freezing status condition of the skill ""Freezing Ray"" while the concentration buff is active.
- Removed the effect that sets target on fire from the skill ""Fire Storm"".
- Changed the skill ""Evil Dragon's Erosion"" so that the amount of damage its user receives will not be affected by the damage rate of difficulty setting.
- Changed the skill ""Lightning Bolt"" so that its lightning will land within a narrow area while the concentration buff is active.
- Increased the damage the skill ""Stalking Strike"" deals to shields.
- Buffed the effect of ""Fishers Life"" at max level so that regular fish can no longer be caught.

◆ Functional Improvements
- Changed the display order so that icons such as quest icons now appear in front of the teleporting button in the map screen.
- Removed a ""WIP"" display from Traditional Chinese language setting.
- A text indicator will appear in the bottom left corner to show that mods are in use when you're using mods from the Steam Workshop.
Note: This does not appear if the mods are installed from sources other than the Steam Workshop.
- When the number of items offered exceeds the offering limit, excess items will be converted into cash now.
- Added a button to zoom in/out. You can press Alt key and control the camera distance by mouse wheel by default.
- Map markers can now be named.
- Player characters will now wake up at dawn when they skip a night in bed.
- Items can now be registered onto hotbar by clicking on items while pressing down the coresponding hot key.
- A confirmation popup will now appear when attempting to quit the game using the × button during gameplay.
- A warp confirmation popup will now appear when pressing the ""Return to a Start Point"" button in the ESC menu.
- Added a feature to mark items as favorite to the crafting UI.
- You can now offer more items than required for Picture Book offering. Exceeding the limit grants 1.5 times the item's sale price.
- When loading fails, the specific file that failed to load will now be displayed.
- Items will not be spawned on objects that deal damage to items upon contact.
- Added warp portals in ""Miasma Wetlands"" and ""Inferno Volcano"".
- Increased the range that you could pick up items.
- Item stack which contains various enchantments will now display the list of enchantments in the inventory.
- Retrieving Rod can now retrieve vehicles.
- Changed a detector so that uncollected Soul Orbs will not be marked as found.
- Fixed a Japanese text of Mounted Machine Gun.
- A cold resistance effect has been added to the ""Campfire"". It will be automatically applied when you are nearby.
- Added ""Mechanics Cargo for Woman"" to the lineup of the merchant in Yarden Meadows.
- Improved the search of pipeline connection target to prioritize inlet and outlet of the targeted pipeline.
- The number of items you enchant on Enchanting Table can now be modified.
- Excavators can now be turned on/off.
- Changed Livestock Farm so that it drops items once it finishes producing them when it's connected to droppers and pipelines.
- Quest NPCs will now have unique dialogue when the player has not reached the required level to accept a quest.
- Certain actions now have priority, so when multiple actions occur at the same time, the higher-priority one will be executed.
- Freezing status effect will now be immediately removed when the character's Life reaches 0.
- Changed the direction that your pets will face when summoned.
- The amount of Life regenerated while a pet is in the inventory will now increase based on its maximum Life.
- Added a function to fully restore your pets Life to the Pet Management Machine.
- Updated the description of the skill ""Full Moon"".

- Fixed a bug that you couldn't swap items registered on hotbar with skills.

- Fixed a bug that Air Balloons could not float in the air when the FPS was too low.
- Fixed a bug that equipment items that cannot be used as appearance were displayed in Appearance Loadout screen.
- Fixed a bug related to Appearance equipment.
- Fixed an issue that the enchantments on the item retrieved by ""Recovery Drone Base"" would disappear.
- Fixed a bug that connections to Sorting Pipes were not properly synchronized for guest players in the multiplayer.
- Fixed a bug that a water surface of fountains would flicker.
- Fixed a bug related to sound effects played from characters.
- Fixed a bug that shields of boss monsters would not be recovered sometimes.
- Fixed a bug that cannonballs fired by Bombardment would not pass through the ground.
- Fixed a bug where Bombardment would activate and fire in an unintended direction.
- Fixed an issue where the close-range breath projectiles of the boss ""Tyrant Snake"" could travel in unexpected directions.
- Reduced an issue where pets could appear to float when moving downhill while mounted.

notes.title: 2024 Winter Update Patch v20241219.1835
notes.content:
◆ Newly Added Content
- Added the age ""Age of Gods"". New items are also added to craft along with the age.
- The ""Monster"" section is added to Picture Book. Defeated monsters will be recorded in Picture Book.
- The game will now recommend the settings based on your computer when you launch the game for the first time.
- Added the biome ""Inferno Volcano"". It's way hotter than ""Unnefell Desert"", so you should prepare carefully for its scorching heat. The dungeon of ""Inferno Volcano"" will be unlocked in a later update.
- ""Merchant Smith"" seems to be visiting a village in ""Miasma Wetlands"". You might find the rare equipment that you've never seen before.
- Added new items. You can craft them at ""Workbench"".
- Master Machine Factory
- Master Blacksmith
- Master Armory
- Master Furnace
- Master Refinery
- Innovative Workbench
- Global Market
- Added new Weapons.
- High Mithril One-Handed Sword
- High Mithril Pickaxe
- High Mithril Axe
- High Mithril Two-Handed Sword
- High Mithril Bow
- High Mithril Spear
- High Mithril Magic Staff
- High Mithril Katana
- High Mithril Shield
- High Mithril Ring
- High Mithril Amulet
- High Mithril Arrow
- Atlach-Nacha
- Jörmungandr
- Joukahainen
- Crimall
- Jorogumo
- Kayomart
- Holy Sword of Gratitude
- Morgul Knife
- Hayate's Bow
- Shield of Aegis
- Tombokiri
- Branch of the World Tree
- Murakumo
- Anti-Whale Pike
- Added new Materials.
- rare bone
- Added new Vehicles.
- Hovercar
- Fish-shaped Missile
- Added new items.
- High Mithril Ingot
- High Mithril Chest
- Artificial Bedrock of High Mithril
- Sorting Pipe
- Guard Machinegun Turret Lv50
- Machine Gun Ammo
- Cannon Ball
- Added new Modules.
- Machine Gun Muzzle
- Cannon Muzzle
Putting the ammunitions for each muzzle in the inventory of the muzzle-attached vehicles allows you to shoot them.
- ""Fishing"" is reworked!
You will now press the displayed buttons in a short period of time to fish, instead of just waiting around!
Fishing sometimes gives you Enchantment Scrolls. They might have fishing exclusive rare enchantments, or it might not?
- Changed the maximum level of a player to 70.
- Added the gigantic raid boss ""Inferno Whale"".
Lure the abandoned pitiful bio-weapon to the hunting field and take it down using your vehicles and hunting equipment!
1. Head to the hunting grounds located in Inferno Volcano. Look for the fortress equipped with a Gigantic Gong.
2. Choose your favorite vehicle. The ""Buggy"" and ""Combat Helicopter"" are highly recommended!
3. Ram your vehicle into the Gigantic Gong. The ""Inferno Whale"" will soon appear!
4. Patrol the hunting grounds in your vehicle and make full use of the various hunting equipment. The equipment you can use will vary depending on your vehicle!
5. Pay special attention to the ""Anti-Whale Pike"" and ""Gigantic Chain Restraint Bullet"", as they are key tools!
    • ""Anti-Whale Pike"": Activate it by attacking the buttons with your vehicle or ramming into them! Not only it can prevent the ""Inferno Whale"" from crushing the fortress, but if you time your first hit well, you can deal massive damage!
    • ""Gigantic Chain Restraint Bullet"": Fire it as ""Inferno Whale"" jumps over the equipment. This will cause the Inferno Whale to crash and remain immobile for a while. Take this opportunity to climb onto its back and destroy the spine-like energy tanks for massive damage! Additionally, destroying all three spines might unlock a special recipe...!
6. Don’t worry if you fail! Talk to ""Anti-Whale Captain Dora"" at the fortress, and the hunting equipment will be repaired, allowing you to try again! If you're unsure how to use the equipment, it’s a good idea to read the instruction signs near each one!
- Added the pet ""Mini Inferno Whale"".
You need to craft ""Captured Mini Inferno Whale"" with the residue of ""Inferno Whale"" to have them as pets.
- Various new skills are added.

◆ Balance Adjustments
- The items dropped by ""Transfer Receptionist Fam"" will now have special enchantments.
- The distance limit of enemies hatred will now be depending on their sight limit.
- Changed the required item for the quest ""Spoils of Victory"" from ""Goblin's Club"" to ""Goblin's Club II"".

◆ Functional Improvements
- Modified the visual design of d-pad icons to increase its visibility.
- The physics system update processing settings have been changed.
*If you notice any issues, please let us know.
- Unlearned skills will not be registered onto hotkeys by the hotkey loadout feature now.
This change will not remove the registered unlearned skills from your hotkey. Please manually remove them if you do so.
- You can now fish some items other than fish.
- Your camera position will now be reset when you get off a vehicle.
- Changed the way how enemies' positions are synced in the game.
This change will reduce the issue that some enemies have periodically teleported for a short distance in Multiplayer. If you notice other issues related to this change, please feel free to report it to us.
- Changed the sound effect setting of enemies.
- Some special enemies will ignore ""Talisman Flag"" and spawn.
- The enemies related to the boss ""Fafnir"" will now spawn when you remove ""Talisman Flag"" while the spawning conditions are met.
- Enchantments' effect on pets is now displayed in the pet item detail screen.
- Modified the spawning range of the boss in the dungeon ""Labyrinth of Pollution"".
- Added the button that resets the positions of balls in the dungeon ""Quicksand Labyrinth"".
- You can now change the friendly fire setting in the custom difficulty setting. Friendly fire means that players' attacks deal damage to other players and might make other players knock back. It's enabled by default.

◆ Performance Improvements
- Optimized the memory usage of some visual effects.

◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug that an opened treasure chest has spawned when the chest has spawned in the area where another opened chest exists.
- Fixed a bug that you could set fire on rocks and ores.
- Fixed a bug that the ""Resurrect at the start"" button couldn't be pressed with game pads while your character is dead.
- Fixed a bug that the game was not rendered properly around the castle gate in ""Millewind Hills"".
- Fixed a bug that the appearance of Pumpkin in Brigandine Valley would remain after you collect.
- Fixed a bug that the weather in biomes was not refreshed right after the game starts.
- Fixed positions of some floating ores.
- Fixed a bug that Refining Level UI was displayed for the items which cannot be refined.
- Adjusted the brightness of some weapons which have glowing effect.
- Fixed a bug that the name of the item that teaches how to craft ""Red Light Armor for Women"" was named ""Blueprint of Black Light Armor for Women"".
- Fixed a bug that ""Buggy"" could run backwards faster than our intention.
- The ""Farming Plot"" entry in Picture Book now states it's uncraftable.
- Fixed a bug that you could deploy Artificial Bedrock more than its maximum number in Multiplayer.
- Fixed a bug that the game might crash when you opened the pet skill page in Pet Management Machine.
- Fixed a bug that some items planted in Farming Plot couldn't be retrieved and/or harvested due to errors such as the connection error.
- Fixed a bug that the Equipment Chest of Refinery was opened when you tried to open Chest for Refining Stone.
- Fixed a bug that the Chest for Retrieved Items of Recovery Drone Base was opened when you tried to open Chest for Specifying Item.
- Fixed hitboxes of ""Medieval Stairs A"" and ""Medieval Stairs B"" to match its appearances.
- Fixed a bug that normal attacks of one-handed swords couldn't hit enemies sometimes.
- Fixed a bug that the successful Shield Bash of a guest player didn't work properly in Multiplayer.
- Fixed a bug that the number of items stored in a gravestone was unexpectedly smaller than the number of your items when your character died while holding lots of items in the inventory.
- Fixed a bug that the item was somehow rendered at a wrong position when you throw the item.
- Fixed a bug that the weapon equipped on your right hand was displayed when you equipped with the Pet's monster prism.
- Fixed a bug that you would receive more damage when you guard if the skill ""Ironclad"" was not learned.
- Fixed a bug that dropped items would be generated undergrounds.
- Fixed a bug that unexpectedly large amount of enemies were spawned at the same time.
- Fixed a bug that defense of the boss ""Fenrir"" was not decreased after all of their destroyable body parts were destroyed.
- Fixed a bug that the boss would start moving while the appearance effect was being played.
- Fixed a bug that ""Virtual Wall"" could limit the movement range of ""Rotating Saws"".
- Fixed a bug that you couldn't summon your pets once the number of charmed mobs reached the maximum number of summoned character.
- Fixed a bug that the seal of the boss room wouldn't be sometimes unsealed if the guest player in Multiplayer disconnected in the boss room.
- Fixed a bug that the sealing countdown visual effect would not disappear in the boss room of dungeons.
- Changed the description of ""Martial Arts: Fist"" to clarify. The effect of the skill hasn't been changed.
- Fixed a bug that Power Attack was not affected by the effect of ""Martial Arts: Fist"".
- Fixed a bug that the rarity effect of ""Martial Arts: Fist"" didn't work properly.
- Reduced the issue that your character would go through walls when you use the skill ""Piercing Talon"".
- Fixed a bug that the Mana cost of some skills was wrongly displayed in the bottom right corner of the inventory.
- Fixed a bug that the ""Show footprint"" option was not applied properly to the game.

notes.title: 4th Anniversary Mini Update Patch v20240903.2309
notes.content:
◆ Newly Added Content
- A new item has been added. It will drop when you defeat the new enemy ""Monobis"" that appears during the 4th anniversary event. - 4th Anniversary Mono Coin 
- New items have been added to celebrate the 4th anniversary.
The following can be crafted at the Blacksmith.
- Monocaliberburn
- Claymono
- Mononoyoichi
- Monononuboko
- Monobis Gold Staff
- Mono16
- Mono Drying Pole (This is a different item from Monohoshizawo!)

The following can be crafted at the Machine Factory
- Mono Balloon

The following can be crafted at the Furniture Workbench
- 4th Anniversary Monoment
The materials for the above items can be obtained during the 4th Anniversary event from September onwards.
- Added a new vehicle. You can craft it at Skilled Machine Factory.
    - CRFT-01(P)
- A level 60 Satyr has been added to the boss area of Owatatsu Archipelago.
- A level 60 Lizard Gunner has been added to the boss area of ​​Sherbert Iceberg.
- A level 60 Griffin has been added to the boss area of ​​Owatatsu Archipelago.
- The timing at which the basic action ""Dodge"" becomes invincible has been sped up, increasing the invincible time.
- You can now change the charm state and the maximum number of enemies to place in the game.
*These settings are for high-spec PCs. Please note that changing the settings may increase the load.

◆ Balance Adjustments
- Increased the maximum number of concurrent random treasure chests in ""Owatatsu Archipelago"", ""Brigandine Valley"", ""Sherbert Iceberg"", ""Unnefell Desert"", and ""Miasma Wetlands"".
- Increased the drop chance of ""Magical Feather"" from random treasure chests.
- Adjusted the basic attack of the ""Spear"" weapon type.
Charge
-Changed so that it can turn while moving.
-Adjusted the camera after accelerating to make it easier to see.
-Reduced stamina consumption.
-Greatly increased the performance of thrust attacks when accelerating, and changed so that the spear throwing buff can be obtained in two stages.

Kick
-Added short-term invincibility and stamina consumption.

Spear Summon
-Moved up the timing at which the spear is judged to have been successfully retrieved.

Just Attack
-Now turns toward the target while attacking.
-Now allows consecutive hits, and the total damage has increased slightly.
- Increased the time it takes to finish eating food etc.
- Decreased the time it takes to finish drinking potions etc.
- The basic attack of the Bow weapon type has been adjusted.
- Damage to weak spots has been greatly reduced, and damage to resistant spots has been greatly increased.
*This adjustment has also been made to the enemy's part damage multiplier, so the actual increase/decrease rate will differ depending on the enemy.
- The basic attack of the Magic Staff weapon type has been adjusted.

Left Just Attack
- Changed the number of hits to single shots and delayed the timing of the attack.

This allows for more attacks when a shield break is successful.

Arcana Bolt
- Changed the search for a homing target to be based on the camera direction rather than the player direction.

Also, for Right Just Attack, the search has been changed to be based on the Just Attack target.

- Greatly increased the projectile speed for Right Just Attack.

- Made the following adjustments to the magic defense down caused by Arcana Bolt.

- No longer canceled when a magic skill hits.

- Changed magic skill damage to shields to no longer be reduced, but instead increased.

- Reduced the amount of damage increase itself, making it uniform regardless of whether or not a focus buff is present.

- Greatly reduced effect duration.
- The basic attack of the Shield weapon type has been adjusted.

Dash attack

- Removed.
- Adjusted the way enemies are blown away when attacked.
- - Changed so that they will not flinch during gale-related animations.
- A goblin nest that drops blueprints for items that require materials found in Yarden Meadow was located within the range of Owatatsu Archipelago, so it has been moved to Yarden Meadow.
- Adjustments have been made to part damage multipliers, mainly for mid-bosses and bosses.
- Extended the duration of stuns caused by shield breaks, etc.
- The following adjustments have been made to the boss ""Dragon"" and ""Desert Dragon"".
-Changed so that intimidation will always be performed after a lava (quicksand) spew attack.
- The following adjustments have been made to the boss ""Fenrir.""
- The durability of destructible parts has been adjusted.
- If all destructible parts are destroyed, the defense power will now be greatly reduced.
- The following adjustments have been made to the bosses ""Griffin"" and ""Autumn Griffin.""
- Greatly increased the duration of the skill ""Wild Might"" and greatly reduced its effect.
- The skill ""Blood Scourge"" now has the ability to turn in the camera direction.
- The damage reaction of the skill ""Leap Strike"" has been strengthened.

◆ Functional Improvements
- The design of the D-pad icon has been improved to make it easier to see.
- Mounts will no longer have a continuous downward force if there is no player in them.

Also, if there is no player in a vehicle and it drops below a certain speed, it will stop instantly.

This will allow vehicles to stop more quickly when dismounted.
- Farms and other areas are now compatible with switching building modes.
- It is now possible to capture and keep Hydra and Tyrant Snake as pets.
- Changed so that pets' ""things"" will no longer multiply when splashed with water.
- We've made a change so that if water is poured on a charmed ""thing"", the multiplied things will also become charmed.
- When progressing through a boss rush dungeon, you will now always be revived from the checkpoint.
- The position of the ""excavator"" that appears at the start of the ""Trial of Destruction"" in Miasma Wetlands has been moved to above the bedrock.
- We have improved the UI display of skills with unlock conditions in the skill tree UI.
- To address a bug where an input signal is sent due to a connection or device malfunction, causing the switching process to occur infinitely and making it impossible to operate the UI, a process has been added that requires a specific button input to switch between keyboard and controller operation.
You can switch with the following buttons.
■ Keyboard → Pad
A button, B button, Start button
■ Pad → Keyboard
Any key, left click
- The name of the ""Wood Drone Base"" has been changed to ""Wood Drone Base Model"".

◆ Performance Improvements
- String operations have been optimized, which is expected to improve UI performance.

◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the camera would shake during certain scenes.
- Fixed an issue where the Enter key character would sometimes be eaten up while typing IME in chat.
- Fixed an issue where random treasure chests could spawn on cliffs or walls.
- Fixed an issue that could cause stuttering during the tower completion animation.
- Fixed an issue where nothing would drop from treasure chests in Miasma Wetlands.
- Some rivers in the Maiazuma Marsh were flooding, so this has been fixed.
- Fixed an issue where characters could easily fall through the wall at (2222.1, 332.5, -140.0) in Brigandine Valley.
- Fixed an issue that caused parts of the giant mushrooms in Miasma Wetlands to be clipped.
- Fixed an issue where some terrain would pass through in the field.
- Adjusted the transparency of the ocean water so that fish can be seen when fishing. 
- Fixed an issue where a sword could be used with the sheath attached when wearing layered armor.
- Fixed minecarts derailing if they were too far away.
- Fixed an issue where players would permanently retain their previous speed after exiting a vehicle.
- Fixed an issue where livestock products could not be transported even if a pipeline was connected to a livestock farm.
- Fixed an issue with the pet management machine's rendering.
- Fixed an issue where the player character's feet would vibrate during certain scenes.
- Fixed an issue where spear summoning was successful much earlier than intended.
- Fixed an issue where equipment would become hidden if you returned to the title after playing with a character using layered clothing, and then started the game with a character not using layered clothing.
- Fixed an issue where layered clothing presets would sometimes not work properly when switching.
- Fixed an issue where enemies would spawn in a wrong position.
- Fixed an issue in the ""Ruin of Beginning"" where the iron ball would sometimes be bounced off enemies.
- Fixed an issue that caused some enemies in the Sherbert Iceberg to spawn underground.
- We have implemented a mitigation measure for the issue where players would sometimes fall through the floor when performing a just attack on the boss ""Fafnir.""
*If this occurs again, we would appreciate it if you could let us know.
- Fixed an issue where the hit detection for the boss ""Fenrir"" was in an unexpected location.
- Fixed an issue where items dropped when destroying parts of the boss ""Fenrir"" would appear underground.
- Fixed an issue that caused progression to be blocked when talking to an NPC with no dialogue.
- The name of the chest in the Pet Management Machine has been corrected to ""Pet Storage"".
- A workaround has been implemented to address an issue where elevators in cave dungeons on the guest side may not function properly during multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue that prevented players from dragging skill icons to scroll in the Skill Tree UI.

notes.title: 2024 Summer Update Patch v20240629.0410
notes.content:
◆ Newly Added Content
- Added the vehicle customization system.
Goblins will now start riding on vehicles out in the field, and they will drop custom parts for vehicles when defeated.
- ""Wedge Tower"" is now available in ""Miasma Wetlands"".
- Added new items. You can craft them at ""Workbench"".
- Angel Wings
- High Performance Jetpack
Those items can be crafted with ""Magical Feather"" that you can obtain from random treasure chests in the field.
- Added the ""Hotkey Loadout"" feature.
- Added new items.
- Spear of Romulus
- Added new items. You can craft them at ""Workbench"".
- Artificial Bedrock
- Added new items. You can craft them at ""Blacksmith"".
- Iron Gauntlet
- Iron Glove
- Gold Gauntlet
- Gold Glove
- Adamantite Gauntlet
- Adamantite Glove
- Mithril Gauntlet
- Mithril Glove
- Added new items.
- Artificial Bedrock of Mithril
- Humanoid enemies will now appear in each regions
Humanoid enemies are maintaining their territory, and the leader of Humanoid enemies will drop items with special enchantments when defeated.
- A new field boss ""Desert Dragon"" has been implemented. The Desert Dragon appears to appear somewhere in the Unnefell Desert. New weapon materials may be dropped by defeating them. 
- Added the new field boss ""Poison Worm"" to ""Miasma Wetlands"".
They might drop material items for new accessories when defeated.
- More mobs can be tamed to make them your pets now.
- Added NPC for the quest ""Subspecies Hunting"".
You can order it from NPC in ""Unnefell Desert"". 
- ""Labyrinth of Pollution"" in ""Miasma Wetlands"" is now available to enter.

◆ Balance Adjustments
- Burning DoT damage will apply slower than before.
- Changed the equipment you could obtain from treasure chests in the field to ""Blueprints"".
Required materials to craft those equipment can be crafted with new ""Abrasives"" items which are suitable to each biomes.
- Adjusted the parameters of the enchantments ""Robber's"" and ""Thief's boss's"".
- Fixed an issue that some field bosses would immediately respawn when you restarted the game.
- Changed so that the boss room of ""Cave of the Raven King"" is not blocked.
- Fixed an issue that reward items from some chests in cavern were unintentionally randomized.

◆ Functional Improvements
- The more Towers you restore, the better rewards you can obtain from treasure chests in the field.
Those chests will respawn at random locations too.
*Please note that some treasure chests will keep respawning at fixed locations too.
- Added ""Retrieve Mode"" which changes the color of targeted buildings to white so you can easily recognize which building to retrieve. You can toggle this mode with the default key ""V"".
- Command Prompt's QuickEdit mode will now be disabled when the dedicated server launches.
- Added the ability to search for crafting recipes in the crafting menu. 
- Reduced the issue regarding the file size of log files.
- Added the sound to the ocean and the rivers in ""Miasma Wetlands"".
- ""Ore Debris"" will now be generated after mining all the ores from its deposit. If you leave ""Ore Debris"", it will slowly regenerate the ores.
- Fixed an issue regarding the rendering of Soul Orbs.
- Items can now be used while a two-handed torch is equipped.
- ""Gun Turret"" of ""War Tank"" will not face towards north whenever you deploy ""War Tank"" now.
- Added the dust effect to running War Tanks.
- ""Retrieving Rod"" will now change the color of the building targeted.
- Changed the direction that the item displayed on the item stand on a wall faces.
- Implemented the ability to quickly stack saved items in chests, defaulting to the Q button.
- Adjusted hitbox to prevent players from getting stuck in breeding stations.
- Improved the performance of Conveyor Belts so it's less likely for carried items to get stuck around the corner of the belts.
- Adjusted the position of mobs produced from ""Clone Breeding Facility"".
- Added the sorting feature and the favorite feature to the list of Enchanting Fragment.
- Added an invinsible time right after you enter or exit a dungeon.
- Added new ""Goblin Dens"" to the field.
- Improved the movement speed while mounting a pet.
- The skill registration status of the hotbar is now saved when you save your skill set.
- It's now easier to do a mid-air jump by the skill ""Double Jump"".
- Improved the critical chance of some skills.
- Adjusted the homing parameter of the skill ""Wind Edge"".

notes.title: About Craftopia's Development
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of Craftopia. Currently, we are receiving a lot of feedback from players regarding Craftopia's development status. 

Based on the opinions and feedback we have received, we would like to tell you a bit about Craftopia's development and the thoughts of the development team. 

At first, Craftopia was developed by just a few people. After receiving a great response from players during the early access launch, we decided to expand the scale of development. As a result, the early access period was extended, but even after years of development, we continue to be actively updating the game, including working on the seamless update, which was the most requested feature by our fans.

Regarding the seamless update, we have made major changes to the fundamentals of the game, which may have caused some inconvenience and dissatisfaction, but we believe it is a major step forward in ensuring that as many people as possible can enjoy the game. We also believe that is a positive step towards a successful official release. 

Currently, the development team has reflected on the seamless update and is focusing on fixing and optimizing important issues rather than adding new content, because we don't want players to suffer from a poor experience when playing the game. As a result of the ongoing fixes we have been doing, we have received reports that people who were previously unable to play are now able to play. 

On the other hand, due to the extended development period, we have heard ongoing concerns that the game may never be completed or that it has been abandoned. This is absolutely not the case. There is nothing to worry about, and the development team is working hard every day towards the official release. Craftopia is our dream game, and we have no intention to stop working on it. 

We have also received some concerns that the release of the company's latest game, Palworld, has negatively affected the development of Craftopia. Again, this is not the case. Palworld was developed by a separate team from Craftopia and has not affected our work on Craftopia. 

Regarding future updates, as per the roadmap, in addition to adding long-term content through major updates, we will also continue to update to the alpha version from time to time to create an environment where you can quickly access new content, as well as assist us in identifying bugs and issues.

As mentioned above, we apologize for the bugs and issues that players have encountered, and the inconvenience caused by our prolonged development.

Craftopia is a game that has grown and improved thanks to the feedback of our players, and the entire team will do its best to develop the game more so that it can be officially released in an even better condition so that everyone can enjoy it. 

Thank you for your continued support of Craftopia. 
Craftopia Development Team

- We have implemented a new vehicle, the minecart!
The minecart can move at high speed on the laid rails, and can even jump. Laying rails can be done in the same way as pipelines.
However, minecarts are vulnerable to attacks from enemies, so be careful where you place them. 
- We have implemented a new pipeline, the sonic pipeline.
Items can be sent out much faster than regular pipelines. 
- We have implemented a new vehicle ""Combat Helicopter""!
A powerful helicopter equipped with machine guns and missiles. 
- We have implemented a new vehicle, the torpedo boat! It can fire torpedoes while moving at high speed on the water.
It is also possible for multiple people to board by sitting at each gun turret. 
- We have implemented a new vehicle “Shark Hoverboard”! Everyone wants to ride, right?
- We have implemented a new vehicle ""Motocross""!
It has better running performance than a regular bike because it has a small turning radius and can jump. 
- New weapons ""Submachine Guns I-III"" have been implemented.
A gun that fires SMG bullets at high speed, making it effective in close-range combat.
- We have implemented a ""clone breeding place"" which is a high-ranking breeding place.
- We have implemented a new intermediate material.
・Tempered glass
・Rare scrap parts
・High performance electronic circuit
・High performance engine
・Chobham Armor
- We have implemented a new item, ``Mithril''!
・Mithril ingot
・Mithril Ax
・Mithril Pickaxe
・Mithril one-handed sword
・Mithril two-handed sword
・Mithril Bow
・Mithril Arrow
・Mithril Shield
・Mithril Spear
・Mithril magic wand
・Mithril Sword
- Added new furniture. You can craft it from the furniture crafting table.
・Log table
・Mushroom desk
・Jack O' Big Shelter
・Mushroom parasol
・Hanging lantern
・Toilet paper holder
・Wall hanging towel
・Pile of red fallen leaves
・Pile of yellow fallen leaves
・Log stool
・Stump stool
・Log bench
・Mushroom stool
・Autumn leaves hanging scroll
- We have implemented the ""Expert Potion Mixer"", which is a high-ranking potion mixer.
- We have implemented a new item 'Portable Portal'.
By placing it on the field, you can use it as a fast travel point.
The maximum number of units that can be installed will increase depending on the number of wedge towers that are repaired! 
- Items ``Whetstone'' and ``Amulet'' have been added.
The added items are as follows.
・Iron whetstone
・Iron Amulet
・Golden whetstone
・Golden amulet
・Adamant steel whetstone
・Adamant Steel Amulet
・Mithril whetstone
・Mithril Amulet
- We have implemented enchantments that exert special effects when added to facilities.
- A new powerful enemy, the Goblem, will appear.
Cunning goblins are exploiting stone golems.
By defeating them, you can obtain materials with special enchantments and accessories. 
- Merchant Smith has opened a shop in ``Sherbert Iceberg'' and ``Unnefell Desert.''
It seems that new weapons can be purchased depending on each biome. 
- We have opened a new age, the Age of Scientific Research. Along with this, you will be able to create new items.

◆ Balance Adjustments
- Due to the preparations for the higher-ranking breeding site, the name of ""Breeding Facility S"" has been changed to ""Breeding Facility.""
- Changed so that some attacks of the boss ""Fafnir"" cannot be avoided.
- The attack power increase due to the two-handed sword's charged buff will now be applied to the skill ""Frog Stomp"".

◆ Functional Improvements
- Improved the appearance of some UI.
- Adjusted the types of logs output on dedicated servers.
- The time until timeout during multi-multiplayer has been extended.
- Changed so that weather effects such as rain and snow stop when you are under the roof.
- Changed the operation of the map stamp button to right mouse click.
- Adjusted the weather in Unnefell Desert.
- The number of times a dual-wielding aerial attack can be activated will now be reset when entering water.
- ""Snowballs"" now spawn on the Sherbert Iceberg.
- The appearance of Crimson Herb, Ultramarine Herb, and Lemon Herb has been changed.
- Added sounds to dual wield and magic staff attacks.
- Adjusted the volume of bow charge.
- The magic wand motion has been slightly modified.
- Added effects to Lizard Sword and Lizard Ax.
- Added voice to ""Noble Frog"".
- Added effects to stone golem.
- Added effects to King Mono.
- Added effects to Lizard Executioner.
- Added effects to Lizard Gunner.
- Added effects to Griffon and Autumn Griffon. The player's Wind Edge magic has also been improved.
- The skill ""Pet Resurrection"" can now only be used when there is a dead pet.
- You can now give up the trial by holding the E key at the pedestal of ongoing trial.
- You can now return when you fall down in some ""Trial of Gliding"" or ""Trial of Speed"".
- A lever has been installed in elevators on the upper and lower floors in the deepest part of the caves. Apart from the central switch, this lever can also be used to operate the elevator. 
- The skill ""Warp Shift"" can now be canceled with various aerial actions.
- Added sounds to boss skills.
- When the skill ""Parry"" successfully deflects a long-range attack, it will now grant invincibility for a certain period of time.
- Adjusted the water splash effects of fishing boats and rafts.
- Brushed up effects for general player skills

◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where quest-issuing NPCs such as captured archaeologists would not be saved after being summoned to the field.
- Fixed an issue where the game pad selection operation would not work properly in the inventory or chest UI after using the enchantment table.
- Fixed a bug that could cause a crash if an invalid ID was specified when using the kick command.
- Fixed an issue where the robot dropping ""Ancient Doll Fragments"" was not rendered on the guest side during multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where the refinement value would increase when attacking buildings etc.
- The position of the soul orb that was buried in the wall in ""Owatatsu Islands"" has been adjusted.
- Corrected the hit detection of palm trees that can be placed with ""Palm Tree Seedling"".
- Fixed an issue where the [Relic] growth tablet could not be used to strengthen Anubis' status.
- The explanation about the function has been removed from the description of ""Wood Drone Base"".
- The phrase ""made from wheat flour"" in the description of ""bioethanol"" has been corrected to ""made from wheat.""
- Fixed a bug where the icon for the item ""Felt Cloth"" was a test icon.
- Fixed an issue where the ""Automatic Furniture Assembly Machine"" had unintended collision detection.
- Fixed an issue where pipelines could not be connected straight after being disconnected.
- Fixed an issue where the production of ""Cauldron"" would not be completed. ""Cauldron"" no longer starts production until it has 1 or more empty slots inside.
Please note that malfunctioning ""Cauldron"" deployed in the field must be destroyed when you want to remove.
- Fixed an issue where guests were unable to use ""Lively Market"".
- Fixed an issue where items transported to the Master Worker's Refinery via the pipeline would disappear.
- Fixed a bug where the items in the chest would multiply if there were not enough items to fit into the chest at the automatic crafting facility.
- We have expanded the accessible range of the ""Sorting Machine"" and ""Three-Way Sorting Machine"" as a countermeasure to the issue of being able to place them below the ground.
- Fixed an issue where weapons (especially spears) would have strange animations when equipped with Balder Armor Black and Predator BDU.
- Fixed an issue where the landing sound would play continuously when the player was fatigued.
- Fixed an issue where the player's head would sometimes disappear at the start of the game if the player was equipped with a layered personal set that did not have head equipment.
- Fixed an issue where Phoenix would keep reviving.
- Fixed an issue where some NPCs would spawn diagonally.
- The UI icon of the pet management machine was still the old model, so it was replaced with the new model.
- Fixed an issue where guests could pass through the terrain when riding the elevator going down to the underground cave during multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where the weapon polishing buff would not be removed after using some skills.
- Fixed an issue where the skill ""Frogstomp"" would not end properly when a multiplayer guest uses it.
- Fixed an issue where critical hits of some skills would not activate.
- Fixed a bug in the UI of the skill "Golden Wind". (No change in effect)
- Fixed an issue where the "Jetpack" effect would appear at an unintended time.
- Fixed an issue where if you retrieved a bench while sitting on a bench placed on the floor, you would warp through the floor and onto the ground.

notes.title: Alpha Version Update Mar.13th
notes.content:
[h3]■ Important[/h3]
This update contains content for the Craftopia [b]alpha-unstable[/b] version.

The [b]alpha-unstable[/b] version allows you to experience new content in advance but there may be unstable behaviour, bugs, and specification changes.
In addition, there may be issues that affect save data.
We recommend making backups of your save data and only playing after understanding and agreeing to this in advance.

[h3]■Update Topic[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where the player's head would sometimes disappear at the start of the game if a layered set without head equipment was equipped. 
- Fixed an issue where the module attached to the "Recovery Drone Base" would not work on the nearest chest. 
- Fixed an issue where the iron ball puzzle in certain dungeons would not disappear even if it fell, making it impossible to proceed.

*In addition to this, various other changes are included!

[h3]■ How to Participate in alpha-unstable[/h3]
Right-click on "Craftopia" in your Steam library and open "Properties."
Select "Beta" and change "Participate in beta" to "alpha-unstable."
Wait for the game to download the new build and then launch it.

● Reporting Bugs
When reporting bugs, please provide detailed information about what you were doing, what you were trying to do, and the circumstances before and after the bug occurred. Additionally, if you have images or videos of the bug at the time of occurrence, it would be appreciated if you could attach them.
Please attach files such as "save data" or "log files" that may be required for bug fixes when reporting.

notes.title: 2024/01/22 Update Patch v20240110.1940
notes.content:
◆ Critical Bug Fixes and Improvements
- We have introduced mitigations to prevent the output log size from increasing over time on dedicated servers.
- Fixed an issue where enemies would not move on dedicated servers.
- Fixed an issue where a warp would occur underground in a cave, causing the player to move to an unintended location in some cases.

◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where a rotating saw would be installed after a certain amount of time with it equipped.
- Fixed an issue where if you used a bed placed outside a certain area, you would continue to be treated as being inside the area.
- Fixed an issue where plants planted in planters would sometimes become non-existent on the guest side.
- Fixed an issue where the player's starting position was not saved on dedicated servers.
- Fixed an issue where the pet would attack the player when using a taunt when summoning a pet.

notes.title: 2023/12/28 Update Patch v20231226.1814
notes.content:
◆ Functional Improvements
- When connected to a dedicated server, the ""Network Mode"" in the Craftopia Feedback Form has been changed to automatically change to ""Multiplayer (Client & Dedicated Server)"".
- Potions can now be used while buildings are equipped.
- The suction power of 'Absorber' has been restored to the original value.
*We will reconsider the issue of not being able to suck up items on the conveyor belt. 
- Players are now granted invincibility for a period of time after respawning.

◆ Bug Fixes
- Removed creative mode island level commands from dedicated servers.
- Fixed an issue where multi-byte characters would become garbled when using commands such as ""say"" on a dedicated server.
- Fixed an issue where vehicles would become inoperable after accessing a vehicle chest.
- Fixed an issue where time would not skip to morning even if you went to bed on a dedicated server.
- Fixed an issue where the value of continuous damage such as burning damage would be an unintended value.
- Fixed an issue where the Sandworm would become unable to move when a ""Shield Bash"" or ""Counter"" with the sword was successful against the Sandworm.
- Fixed an issue where messengers of the underworld would multiply in the Old Garden of Massacre under certain conditions.
- Fixed an issue where Feather Scroll would not activate in certain terrain.
- Fixed an issue where Grimnoir would not activate in certain terrain.
- Fixed an issue with the effect of the skill ""Seismic Charge"".
- Fixed an issue with the effect of the skill ""Grimnoire"".
- Fixed an issue where some skill icons were displayed at low resolution.
- Fixed an issue where the volume settings were not reflected in some skills.

notes.title: Plans for Future Development
notes.content:
Hello! 
Thank you for your continued support of Craftopia. 

2023 was the year we celebrated two major events: the seamless world update and our 3rd anniversary. 
Immediately after the seamless update was released, optimization issues and bugs caused trouble for everyone. We spent a lot of time fixing many of these issues and we continue to do so with the support of players who send us regular bug reports. Currently, we have succeeded in significantly improving the performance of the game in our November update. We have received reports from people who were unable to play the game before that they can now play it. We would like to take this opportunity to sincerely apologize and thank all the players who have supported us. 

In the roadmap we released for 2023, we planned to add more new content, but for the past few months, we have been prioritizing bug fixes and optimization so that everyone can enjoy a stable game. Due to this, the implementation of some of the planned content was delayed. In 2024, we plan to continue resolving various issues and implementing new elements as we move toward the official release. 
Please take a look at the summary of what is planned to be implemented in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37878653/79e9928ad3ef89f359955249f8e044f7ce9b92a0.png[/img]

We plan to continue working on content in our roadmap as well as more content that we want to develop beyond that. 
The entire development team will continue to work on making Craftopia an even better game, so please continue to support Craftopia! 
Craftopia development team

notes.title: Desert & Dedicated Server update Patch v20231218.1856
notes.content:
[h2][b]◆◆◆Update Topic◆◆◆[/b][/h2]

[h3]・Dedicated Server has been released on a trial basis.
We plan to continue optimizing and fixing issues to ensure stable operation.

・New biome "Unnefell Desert" has been partially opened.
Some content such as era level and dungeons will be released in the next update.

・A new type of skill "Boss Skill" has been implemented.
These are powerful skills that can be acquired by defeating certain bosses.

・The Lv cap has been raised and it is now possible to level up to Lv60.

・Specifications have been adjusted to improve operability during pipeline installation.[/h3]


◆ Newly Added Content
- We have opened Dedicated Server on a trial basis as preparations for Dedicated Server, which was temporarily closed due to the transition to a seamless world, have been completed.
Due to changes in specifications, problems such as stabilization, optimization, and defects may occur, so we plan to continue making improvements based on reports. 
- Partial release of new biome ""Unnefell Desert"".
New age, dungeons, quests from NPCs, caves, SHOP, etc. will be released at a later date.
A new field boss is also scheduled to appear.
- Based on your feedback, we have improved the usability when installing pipelines.

- Changed the pipeline logic to make it less likely that unintended behavior would occur.
- Adjusted so that the pipes being installed are automatically guided to the connectable end of each pipe.
-Until now, you had to press and hold to install, but pressing the left click once starts the connection, and pressing it again confirms the installation.
If you right-click while the connection is starting, the connection will be canceled.
-When installing a relay pipe, the connection state is now maintained. This allows continuous laying.
-Jumping during installation will no longer cancel the connection state.

Other issues remain, such as installing it in a high place, so we will continue to improve operability and prepare the upper pipeline. 
- A new skill ""Boss Skill"" has been added. This is a new skill that can be learned by defeating dungeons and field bosses.
-Seismic Charge
-Will-O-Wisp
-Psychogun
-Feather squall
-Frog Stomp
-Dragon Tail
-One sword cut
-Golden Wind
-Grimnoire
Boss skills other than those listed above will be added in the future. 
- The Lv cap has been opened. It will be possible to raise the character's level up to 60.

◆ Balance Adjustments
- The production efficiency when producing ""water"" using a cooking pot has been significantly increased. Along with this, the water purification power of water purification facilities has improved dramatically.
- It is now possible to create the item ""Sand"" by baking stones at high heat using a ""Furnace"".
- Adjusted the speed of the following vehicles.
- Hoverboard
- Motorcycle
- Biplane
- The suction power of ""Absorber"" has been increased by 5 times.
- Adjusted the dual wield left attack.
- Reduced the spawn time of enemy spinning saws.

◆ Functional Improvements
- Added resurrection options upon death. Depending on the location, you can select ""last used portal,"" ""dungeon entrance,"" or ""cave entrance.""
- Placed a crystal at the base of the tower. This is a solution to the problem of difficult to understand tower elevators.
- Added a new icon to the Great Sword of Resurrection underground in the full map.
- Changed the motion of the bow.
- Fixed an issue where the reticle and body would overlap when shooting a bow without right-clicking to change the camera position.
- We received feedback that fishing floats were difficult to see at night, so we made adjustments to make them a little brighter.
- Changed the appearance of markets, lively markets, cooking pots, and cauldrons.
- Changed the tank engine sound.
- Changed the hoverbike engine sound.
- Changed the appearance of the pipe entrance and exit.
- When collecting a wall or pet that has a module such as an ``Item Frame,'' the items in the ``Item Frame'' will also become drop items.
Along with this, when a pet with a module dies, the module will now disappear. 
- We have changed the way pipeline connections work.
Changes:
You can now select the entrance of a pipe without right-clicking and holding.It is no longer possible to install a pipe without connecting it to the entrance.
With the connection selected, you can extend the pipe beyond the crosshair or select the exit, and you can cancel the connection by right-clicking. 
- Expanded the hit detection for item collection for ""Large Capacity Container"".
- The Dragon Mail, Mechanic Cargo, Elemental Robe, Leather Cuirass, Leather Corset, Wizard Cloak, Smart Casual Attire, Farmer's Overalls, and Fur Coat♂ models are aligned with their normal naked bodies.
- Added sounds to Noble Frog and Dragon's attacks. We plan to add others in due course
- The following monsters can now be caught.
- Wild Rotating Saws
- Holy Knight
- Cyclops
- Ancient Golem
- Messenger of the Underworld
- Lizard Executioner
- Lizard Gunner
- Fleur
- Griffon of the Golden Season
- Fenrir
- Bone Dragon
- Changed the color of the numbers and added a hint message when the number of pets owned has reached the maximum in the pet management machine.
- The quest delivery UI has been changed so that items that cannot be stacked by equipment or enchantment can be delivered all at once.
- Adjusted so that the target of Anubis' Trial ""Sniper's Trial"" faces the pedestal.
- The time limit for some of Anubis' Trials ""Sniper Trials"" has been extended.
- Along with the ability to capture bosses, it is now possible to capture bosses in the dungeon's boss room.
- Added skill sounds mainly for active skills.
- Added an effect to a weapon that does not have an effect when just attacking.
- Adjustments were made in response to feedback that the Magic Shield effect was too bright.
- Added the following to the description of the skill ""Double Jump"": ""When strengthened to the maximum, it becomes a triple jump.""
- Added the ability to specify a button to return to the previous page in the page switching function of the hotbar.The default is no button and can be set from the key binding screen.
- Added key bindings for hotkeys 0 to 9 to the settings screen so that they can also be set on the gamepad.

◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the era level of the world was displayed one level lower when selecting the world in the home scene.
- Fixed an issue where the feather hiding function did not work for character equipment on the inventory screen.
- Fixed an issue where the vehicle could not accelerate unless the forward and dash buttons were pressed at the same time. Added a boost button display for the vehicle being operated under the HUD.
- Fixed an issue where item tags would be displayed on the screen when other players are using the recovery rod in multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where the boss ""Fafnir"" would become a [relic] item when captured.
- Fixed an issue where players could slip through the spiral staircase inside the castle in Brigandine Valley.
- Fixed an issue where the fishing water surface effect was emitting light.
- Fixed an issue where the tree and stump states were not synchronized correctly when participating in a multiplayer game.
- Fixed an issue where biome warp icons would not appear on the map after repairing a tower.
- Fixed a bug where the top of the ""balloon"" was not rendered.
- We have introduced measures to reduce the load due to a large number of dropped items.
We regularly enable/disable physics calculations for dropped items that are determined not to have moved significantly.
Due to this response, in rare cases, dropped items may not move for a few seconds. 
- The ""Rotating Saw"" that was placed beyond the limit and became unrecoverable will now return to an item.
- Fixed an issue where hoverboards would move forward at abnormal speeds after jumping over water.
- Fixed an issue where guests could collect chests with contents during multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where the ""Offshore Oil Plant"" would sometimes look strange as a guest.
- Fixed an issue where objects would continue to slide when carrying buildings on a conveyor belt using gravity gloves.
- An issue where the ""excavator"" would float on the river surface has been changed so it can no longer be installed there.
- Fixed a bug where the ""excavator"" could be placed so that it was buried in a wall.
- Fixed an issue where fillets could not be removed from green sea turtles using the fillet machine.
- Fixed an issue where guests were sometimes unable to collect chests.
- Fixed an issue where the ""reaper"" might not work properly.
- Fixed an issue where the predicted placement of ""Fortress Staircase Handrail A"" was not as expected.
- Fixed an issue where the collision detection for ""Citadel Stairs A"" was incorrect for multiplayer guests.
- Fixed an issue where the items ""Fortress Small Candle Stand"", ""Fortress Large Candlestand"", ""Fortress Small Chandelier"", and ""Fortress Large Chandelier"" were not displayed for guests during multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where ""Shop Stand B"" would rotate when placed.
- Fixed an issue where the hit detection for ""Log House Stairs A"" would be incorrect on the guest side during multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where the string ""Test"" was displayed for enchantments that had no effect, such as ""Hand-washed"" or ""Reinforced"", so that they now display ""No effect"".
- Fixed an issue where some enchantments would be displayed twice in the enchantment fragment list.
- On the enchantment table, the item details at the bottom right can now be pressed even if it overlaps with ""Select enchantment to apply."" The layout etc. will be improved in the future.
- Fixed an issue where there were mesh holes in the ears of some faces.
- Introduced mitigations for an issue where players could get stuck in small gaps.
- Fixed an issue where the attack sounds of some bosses could be heard even from a distance.
- Fixed an issue where mobs' maximum HP and maximum shield values were not synchronized correctly when a multiplayer guest joined in the middle.
- Fixed an issue where physics calculations were not performed for enemies that are not charm pets in the monolith.
- Fixed an issue where when a guest shield broke an enemy, shield breaks would occur continuously.
- Fixed an issue where the follow instructions for multiplayer guests' pets would not work properly.
- Fixed an issue where coordinates of modules attached to pets were not synchronized when joining as a guest.
- Fixed an issue where missions and quests would not progress even after defeating some goblins and gremlins.
- Fixed an issue where a message indicating that the trial cannot be started was displayed only to the host in multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where there were walls that could be clipped through in Frozen Ruins.

notes.title: Craftopia and The Steam Awards 2023!

notes.title: Craftopia Celebrates Its 3rd Anniversary!
notes.content:
On September 4, 2023, Craftopia celebrates its 3rd anniversary since its release! It is only because of your support that we are able to continue developing Craftopia to this day! 

To commemorate the 3rd anniversary, we will be implementing some small commemorative items into the game this year as well as furniture items requested by winners of architectural design contests held in the past, so please be sure to craft them. 

After about a year and a half of development, Craftopia was made seamless at the end of June, and the game's mechanics were greatly improved from the previous format of moving between islands. We have made various changes to the game system and rebuilt it into a game that can be enjoyed by those who have left Craftopia and those who are playing it for the first time, so even those who have not played it yet after making it seamless, please try playing it once! 

However, there are still issues to be solved, and we are working on improvements, not only in terms of game balance, but also in identifying the causes of problems that can put a heavy load on the game in certain environments. We are also currently working on support for Xbox, which has received a lot of feedback, so please look forward to further updates. 

We have passed one big hurdle: making it seamless, but we will continue to work together with everyone to advance development towards our 4th anniversary, so please continue to support Craftopia! 

Craftopia Development Team

notes.title: Announcement on Mod Development
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Craftopia.

We announce that the way how to output log files has been changed since the update on Aug. 21st, 2023.

This change was made during our optimization process, and might affect you if you want to check error logs with "BeplinEx" during the development of mods.

In order to output logs, you should create `[b]NoCustomLogger.txt[/b]` within [b]%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\PocketPair\Craftopia[/b].
But please note that this will disable optimization changes along with error logs output, and possibly lower down the client performance.

Thank you for your understanding and your continued supports.

notes.title: Answers to your recent questions and reports
notes.content:
As always, thank you for all your helpful bug reports and feedback so far! 
Regarding the following reports and inquiries that we are currently receiving from many people, we would like to provide you with some information and guidance where possible. 

[Regarding corrupted save data]
We are currently receiving reports that "save data is not saving" and "save data is corrupted", and we are urgently investigating the cause and making improvements.
We suspect that synchronization with the Steam Cloud system may be the cause of this problem, so we have temporarily changed the settings so that synchronization with the Steam Cloud is not performed.
We apologize for the inconvenience this may cause, but please understand.
In addition, we are gradually incorporating mitigation measures for this bug, so please give us a bit more time to fully resolve this issue.

[Regarding becoming stuck on terrain]
Currently, we have received reports characters becoming stuck and unable to move due to getting stuck in the terrain.
If you encounter this problem, we have prepared a "Return to the starting point" button in the Esc menu. 
Based on the reports we received, we are working on correcting locations where characters are frequently becoming stuck due to the terrain, so if you encounter it, please try this workaround. 

[About bugs caused by MODs]
Some bug reports and issues we have received reports on appear to have been caused by mods.
Craftopia has greatly changed and the internal specifications have been drastically altered due to seamless updates.
For this reason, there are mods that may have worked normally in the old Craftopia, but do not work properly after the seamless update, and as a result cause problems.
If this is the case for you then we recommend unsubscribing from all mods.
Since mods are made by volunteers on the Steam workshop, it is difficult for us to respond to bug reports related to mods. You may have to wait for the mod itself to be updated or the mod may not be compatible anymore. We hope that you understand.

[About verifying game files]
We have confirmed that some problems can be improved by verifying your game files on Steam.
You can do this from your game properties on Steam by right-clicking the game then goi  to: “Properties" > "Local files" > "Verify integrity of game files".
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please try this first if you are experiencing any issues. 

We are doing our best to respond to other bugs and feedback as soon as possible, and we will continue to make improvements.
Thank you for your continued support of Craftopia.

Pocketpair Development Team

notes.title: Development Status
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After a long time waiting we finally were able to release the seamless update and we have been enjoying reading about your adventurers in the new Craftopia.

However, we are keenly aware that this update has brought its fair share of problems and we want to assure you that the team is doing everything they can to resolve these issues as soon as possible.
There are some sleepless nights ahead but we want to make Craftopia a game that you can enjoy for a long time.

Among the issues with the update, we'd like to briefly update you on some of the serious ones:

1: GPU/CPU issues:
We are aware that some users are experiencing problems with high CPU usage and GPUs running hot. We really appreciate all the bug reports you sent in and the information you provided about this issue.
In the first hotfix, we fixed an issue that was causing high GPU and CPU usage in the main menu. We've identified some other factors that may still be causing issues in-game and we are hoping to have them fixed in an upcoming update.
We understand that this is a priority and we are doing what we can to resolve this issue as soon as possible.

2: Japanese text in the English version and mistranslations:
Due to a bug with our localization system, several instances of text defaulted to the Japanese version despite the game being set to the English version. We apologize for this and are doing our utmost to correct this as fast as we can. 
Also, due to the large amount of text in Craftopia, there are also some translations that may appear unusual or difficult to read. This is an ongoing effort and we will continue to work to correct these. 

3: Multiplayer connectivity issues:
The decision to not release the dedicated server alongside the update was a difficult one to make but unfortunately, it just wasn't ready in time. We know many players have been experiencing issues connecting to multiplayer p2p games and we are looking into measures we can take to mitigate these problems. Often these issues are a result of firewalls or ports but we are exploring options to ease these problems on our end. 

There are more bugs and issues that we are aware of and we sincerely thank everyone for their bug reports and encourage you to continue sending us this info.

We will be rolling out more fixes and patches so please keep an eye out for those.
Of course, we are also working on new content, new areas and new mechanics as the world of Craftopia will continue to grow! Please look forward to these updates and check out the roadmap we recently posted.
We have big plans for Craftopia and we are looking forward to sharing them with you all.

Everyone here will keep working hard and as always, we thank you for your continued support. 

- Pocketpair
